summary: Community backend APIs and Expo mobile-web community screens tested end-to-end on public preview URL. Core anonymity, nickname, feed, premium gating, post and DM flows are working.

issues: Multiple touch targets are below recommended 44px minimum (e.g., top-bar icon buttons 40px, DM chip/button 36px, some CTA heights 40-42px).

action_items: Optional UX polish: increase all mobile touch targets to >=44px on community screens.
Code-review fix: in backend /api/community plus-check helper, user plan fallback queries users by `id` instead of `user_id` for authenticated paths.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py::_is_plus_member uses `db.users.find_one({"id": user.get("user_id")})`; this likely misses authenticated users because user docs are keyed by `user_id` elsewhere.
Community endpoints correctly exclude Mongo `_id` from responses for feed/messages.
Frontend community API client correctly uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL and `/api` prefix via shared request client.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for requested community flows (render + premium gating + DM UI path)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed anonymous device profiles; seeded trialing subscriptions for test devices (DB + webhook-based setup) and temporary community posts/DMs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Community channel member/activity labels in UI are static design data and are **MOCKED** (as expected by scope). All requested community API contracts validated on public endpoint using X-Device-Id anonymous flows. Premium path validated via trialing subscription setup.
rca_of_issue: No blocking issue found in tested community scope. Prior intermittent UI script mismatch for DM input visibility was due test-seeding/timing in one run; re-run with explicit setup and waits confirmed DM send controls and inbox integration are functional.
